outcome: A copy of a prototype card has the same alternative mana cost, power and toughness available.
A prototyped spell is judged for casting using only the alternative mana cost, so can_play and cost differ from casting normally.
A prototyped spell and its permanent have the alternative power, toughness and mana cost, and the colors of that cost.
A copy of a prototyped spell is prototyped and has the alternative power, toughness and mana cost.
A copy of a permanent that was a prototyped spell has the alternative power, toughness and mana cost.
A prototype card not cast as a prototyped spell, and in every other zone, has only its normal characteristics.
A prototyped permanent keeps its other characteristics, such as types and abilities, unchanged apart from power, toughness, mana cost and color.
